== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ブラフ（断崖）</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここでは「ブラフ・ルール」が適用される。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここでは「ブラフ・ルール」が適用される。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Bluffs]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The printed title adds （断崖） after ブラフ. Both sides print ここでは「ブラフ・ルール」が適用される. English prints 'Bluff Rules' in effect here. No Force icons. Exterior and Planet icons on both sides.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-tatooinebluffs.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Bluffs]].</ref>
